description: This file defines a utility class 'SessionUtil' for handling HTTP session attributes, providing methods to get, set, and remove session attributes within a web application.

classes.name: SessionUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for session attribute management in web applications.

methods.name: getSessionAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute casted to a generic type `<T>` from the HTTP request session.

methods.name: removeSessionAttribute
methods.description: Removes the specified session attribute from the HTTP request session.

methods.name: setSessionAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with the specified key and value in the HTTP request session.
